basic_info.description: Gorgeous semi-detached single family home in the Sunnydale District. The property upon entry features a spacious living room area with a cozy semi open kitchen space. There is one office room located at the front of the property. The hallway leads to a full bathroom with an additional shower room. Two bedrooms are also located on the main level with stair leading to the downstairs in-law. The lower level includes a bedroom with an office space with an family room with kitchen combo. The lower has a full bath also with a one car parking space. The property has a space back yard with driveway parking available for the San Francisco convenient. Easy access to parks highway and transportation. Perfect Starter Home!
